title: Agent Memory and Middleware
summary: This module provides various memory implementations for conversational AI agents to manage chat history and entities, alongside a suite of middleware components to control and enhance agent behavior, including execution policies, PII handling, summarization, and tool interaction.

nodes.label: Define Core Memory Interface
nodes.title: BaseMemory
nodes.description: Abstract base class for managing conversational state and context within AI agents.

nodes.label: Manage Chat Memory Interface
nodes.title: BaseChatMemory
nodes.description: Abstract base for chat-specific memory, handling message storage and retrieval, though not recommended for new code with native tool calling.

nodes.label: Store Full Conversation History
nodes.title: ConversationBufferMemory
nodes.description: Retains the entire conversation history as messages or a single string, without additional processing.

nodes.label: Store String Conversation History
nodes.title: ConversationStringBufferMemory
nodes.description: Stores the entire conversation history as a string, tailored for string-based conversation history.

nodes.label: Store Recent Conversation Turns
nodes.title: ConversationBufferWindowMemory
nodes.description: Keeps track of the last 'k' turns of a conversation, dropping older messages to manage context size.

nodes.label: Summarize Conversation History
nodes.title: ConversationSummaryMemory
nodes.description: Continuously summarizes the conversation history, updating the summary after each conversation turn.

nodes.label: Summarize & Buffer Conversation
nodes.title: ConversationSummaryBufferMemory
nodes.description: Maintains a running summary and recent messages, pruning older content to respect token limits.

nodes.label: Buffer & Vector Store Memory
nodes.title: ConversationVectorStoreTokenBufferMemory
nodes.description: Combines token-buffered chat history with a vector store for long-term memory and retrieval of relevant past interactions.

nodes.label: Extract & Summarize Entities
nodes.title: ConversationEntityMemory
nodes.description: Identifies and summarizes named entities from chat history, using a swappable entity store for persistence.

nodes.label: In-Memory Entity Storage
nodes.title: InMemoryEntityStore
nodes.description: Provides a simple, volatile in-memory storage for conversational entities, suitable for short-lived contexts.

nodes.label: Redis Entity Storage
nodes.title: RedisEntityStore
nodes.description: Persists conversational entities using a Redis database with configurable time-to-live (TTL) for entries.

nodes.label: Upstash Redis Entity Storage
nodes.title: UpstashRedisEntityStore
nodes.description: Persists conversational entities using an Upstash Redis database with configurable time-to-live (TTL) for entries.

nodes.label: SQLite Entity Storage
nodes.title: SQLiteEntityStore
nodes.description: Persists conversational entities using a local SQLite database, ensuring safe query construction.

nodes.label: Prune Tool Results for Context
nodes.title: ContextEditingMiddleware
nodes.description: Automatically prunes tool results to manage context size, applying various edit strategies like clearing tool uses.

nodes.label: Search Local Filesystem
nodes.title: FilesystemFileSearchMiddleware
nodes.description: Adds tools for glob and grep search operations on the local filesystem, supporting pattern matching and content search.

nodes.label: Enable Human Intervention
nodes.title: HumanInTheLoopMiddleware
nodes.description: Allows human approval, editing, or rejection of agent actions and tool calls, enabling oversight and control.

nodes.label: Enforce Model Call Limits
nodes.title: ModelCallLimitMiddleware
nodes.description: Tracks and enforces limits on the number of model calls per thread or run, with configurable exit behaviors.

nodes.label: Fallback on Model Failure
nodes.title: ModelFallbackMiddleware
nodes.description: Automatically retries failed model calls with alternative models in sequence until success or exhaustion.

nodes.label: Retry Failed Model Calls
nodes.title: ModelRetryMiddleware
nodes.description: Automatically retries failed model calls with configurable backoff and exception handling for robustness.

nodes.label: Detect & Handle PII
nodes.title: PIIMiddleware
nodes.description: Detects common Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and applies strategies like redaction, masking, or hashing.

nodes.label: Detect Credit Card Numbers
nodes.title: detect_credit_card
nodes.description: Utility function to detect credit card numbers in text content using Luhn validation.

nodes.label: Provide Persistent Shell Tool
nodes.title: ShellToolMiddleware
nodes.description: Registers a persistent shell tool for agents, with configurable execution policies and output redaction.

nodes.label: Summarize Conversation for Context
nodes.title: SummarizationMiddleware
nodes.description: Monitors message token counts and automatically summarizes older messages when limits are approached.

nodes.label: Manage Agent Todo Lists
nodes.title: TodoListMiddleware
nodes.description: Adds a 'write_todos' tool for agents to create and manage structured task lists for complex operations.

nodes.label: Update Agent Todo List
nodes.title: write_todos
nodes.description: Function for agents to update their structured task list within the TodoListMiddleware.

nodes.label: Async Update Agent Todo List
nodes.title: _awrite_todos
nodes.description: Asynchronous function for agents to update their structured task list within the TodoListMiddleware.

nodes.label: Enforce Tool Call Limits
nodes.title: ToolCallLimitMiddleware
nodes.description: Tracks and enforces limits on the number of tool calls per thread or run, with various exit behaviors.

nodes.label: Emulate Tool Execution with LLM
nodes.title: LLMToolEmulator
nodes.description: Emulates specified tools using an LLM instead of actual execution, primarily for testing purposes.

nodes.label: Retry Failed Tool Calls
nodes.title: ToolRetryMiddleware
nodes.description: Automatically retries failed tool calls with configurable backoff and exception handling for robustness.

nodes.label: Select Tools with LLM
nodes.title: LLMToolSelectorMiddleware
nodes.description: Uses an LLM to select the most relevant tools from a larger set before calling the main model.

nodes.label: Execute in Codex Sandbox
nodes.title: CodexSandboxExecutionPolicy
nodes.description: Launches shell commands within a Codex CLI sandbox for enhanced security and syscall restrictions.

nodes.label: Execute in Docker Container
nodes.title: DockerExecutionPolicy
nodes.description: Runs shell commands inside a dedicated Docker container for strong isolation between sessions.

nodes.label: Anthropic State Text Editor
nodes.title: StateClaudeTextEditorMiddleware
nodes.description: Provides Anthropic's `text_editor` tool using LangGraph state for file storage, persisting for the conversation thread.

nodes.label: Anthropic State Memory Tool
nodes.title: StateClaudeMemoryMiddleware
nodes.description: Provides Anthropic's memory tool using LangGraph state for file storage, persisting for the conversation thread.

nodes.label: Anthropic Filesystem Text Editor
nodes.title: FilesystemClaudeTextEditorMiddleware
nodes.description: Provides Anthropic's `text_editor` tool using the local filesystem for storage, allowing user-managed persistence.

nodes.label: Anthropic Filesystem Memory Tool
nodes.title: FilesystemClaudeMemoryMiddleware
nodes.description: Provides Anthropic's memory tool using the local filesystem for storage, allowing user-managed persistence.

nodes.label: Anthropic State File Search
nodes.title: StateFileSearchMiddleware
nodes.description: Provides glob and grep search over state-based virtual files for Anthropic agents.

nodes.label: Cache Anthropic Prompts
nodes.title: AnthropicPromptCachingMiddleware
nodes.description: Optimizes Anthropic API usage by caching conversation prefixes, system messages, and tool definitions.

nodes.label: Moderate OpenAI Agent Traffic
nodes.title: OpenAIModerationMiddleware
nodes.description: Moderates agent input and output using OpenAI's moderation endpoint for safety and policy compliance.

nodes.label: Language Model
nodes.title: Language Model
nodes.description: An external Language Model (LLM) used for generating text, summaries, entity extraction, or making decisions.

nodes.label: Redis Database
nodes.title: Redis Database
nodes.description: An external key-value store used for persistent storage of conversational entities.

nodes.label: Upstash Redis Database
nodes.title: Upstash Redis Database
nodes.description: A cloud-based Redis service used for persistent storage of conversational entities.

nodes.label: SQLite Database
nodes.title: SQLite Database
nodes.description: A local file-based database used for persistent storage of conversational entities.

nodes.label: Local Filesystem
nodes.title: Local Filesystem
nodes.description: The local file system used for file search, text editing, and shell tool operations.

nodes.label: Codex CLI Sandbox
nodes.title: Codex CLI Sandbox
nodes.description: A secure execution environment provided by the Codex CLI for running shell commands with syscall and filesystem restrictions.

nodes.label: Docker Container
nodes.title: Docker Container
nodes.description: An isolated containerized environment used for executing shell commands, providing strong process isolation.

nodes.label: OpenAI Moderation API
nodes.title: OpenAI Moderation API
nodes.description: An external API service from OpenAI used for content moderation of agent inputs and outputs.

nodes.label: Anthropic API
nodes.title: Anthropic API
nodes.description: The external API service from Anthropic used for LLM interactions and prompt caching features.

nodes.label: Vector Store
nodes.title: Vector Store
nodes.description: An external vector database used for storing and retrieving embeddings, often for long-term memory.

groups.label: Memory Core
groups.title: Core Memory Interfaces
groups.description: Defines the foundational interfaces for managing conversational state and chat history within AI agents.

groups.label: Conversation History Memory
groups.title: Conversation History Memory Implementations
groups.description: Concrete implementations for storing and managing the flow of conversation history, from simple buffers to summarized and windowed views.

groups.label: Entity Memory & Storage
groups.title: Entity Memory and Persistence
groups.description: Components for extracting, summarizing, and persistently storing named entities from conversational contexts.

groups.label: Execution Policies
groups.title: Agent Execution Policies
groups.description: Defines various policies for how external commands and tools are executed, offering different levels of security and isolation.

groups.label: Agent Control & Resilience
groups.title: Agent Control and Resilience Middleware
groups.description: Middleware components that manage the overall flow and robustness of agent operations, including call limits, fallbacks, and retries.

groups.label: Content Processing & Security
groups.title: Content Processing and Security Middleware
groups.description: Middleware focused on processing and securing conversational content, including PII detection, summarization, and context management.

groups.label: Tool Orchestration
groups.title: Tool Orchestration Middleware
groups.description: Middleware components that manage the selection, emulation, and control of tool calls within agent workflows.

groups.label: Agent Utility Tools
groups.title: Agent Utility Tools Middleware
groups.description: Middleware providing agents with built-in utility tools such as shell access, file search, and todo list management.

groups.label: Anthropic Tools
groups.title: Anthropic-Specific Tool Middleware
groups.description: Middleware components providing specialized tool integrations for Anthropic models, such as text editing and memory management.

groups.label: Partner Integration
groups.title: LLM Partner Integration Middleware
groups.description: Middleware for integrating with and optimizing specific LLM provider APIs, including prompt caching and content moderation.
